# Ultra Home Repair — Irvine Tankless Water Heater Service

> Ultra Home Repair provides professional tankless water heater flushing, descaling, diagnosis, and repair in Irvine, California. Owner Dustin Swad specializes in Rinnai tankless water heaters and also works on Rheem, Navien, and Noritz systems.

Ultra Home Repair is based in Woodbury and focuses its tankless water heater service on Irvine homeowners. Standard tankless water heater flushing is $125 for most standard residential units. Service typically takes 1 to 1.5 hours and includes a pre-flush visual inspection, professional heat-exchanger descaling, accessible inlet-filter cleaning, a post-flush rinse, restart verification, and service documentation.

Customers often contact Ultra Home Repair when a tankless water heater displays an error code, stops producing hot water, shuts down, develops reduced flow, takes longer to heat, or is overdue for maintenance. Dustin can diagnose tankless problems, perform appropriate repairs, replace components when needed, and service both condensing and non-condensing systems. Current error-code specialties include Rinnai Code 11 and Rinnai Code 17.

Urgent appointments may be available for Irvine homeowners without hot water. Call or text (949) 371-6423 to check the earliest available appointment. Same-day and 24-hour service are not guaranteed.

Primary brand specialty: Rinnai. Other brands serviced include Rheem, Navien, and Noritz. Ultra Home Repair uses original service photos, real Irvine customer reviews, transparent pricing, and direct owner-provided service.
